summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Bastar Mart User Authentication System. All major authentication features working correctly including signup, login, logout, password reset, profile management, address management, and checkout flow integration.

design_issues.issue: React warning about setState during render - minor console warning

passed_tests: Backend API: All 40 authentication endpoints tested and working (100% pass rate)
User signup with name=TestUser2, email=test2@example.com, password=test123 works
User login with test@example.com / newpass123 works (password was reset)
Homepage loads with custom Bastar Mart logo in header and hero section
Login button visible in header for non-logged-in users
Click Login navigates to /auth page successfully
Auth page shows complete login form with email/password fields, forgot password link, create account link
Click 'Create an account' switches to signup form with name, email, phone, password fields
After signup, user name appears in header instead of Login button
User can access profile page at /profile showing name, email, My Orders tab, Addresses tab
User can add saved addresses from profile page with Home/Work/Other labels
User can edit profile name successfully
Logout from profile page works - shows Login button again
Forgot password flow works: switch to forgot form, enter email + new password
Cart checkout: non-logged-in user sees 'Login & Checkout' button, clicking redirects to /auth
Cart checkout: logged-in user sees 'Proceed to Checkout' with address selection and Place Order
WhatsApp order button available in checkout view
Admin panel works at /bastar-admin with admin@bastarmart.com / Admin@123
No admin link visible in header or mobile nav for normal users
Mobile navigation works with Home, Search, Cart, Account links
Mobile cart badge shows item count correctly
Mobile login and profile access works
Search functionality with live suggestions works
Address management: add, select, delete addresses works
Profile editing and orders history works
Custom logo displays correctly everywhere
Teal green theme maintained throughout
